Selector focus, Tab to return, Escape from task dialog and return focus checked at 1440/680/390px. A 390×480 menu scrolls to its final control within the viewport. Native popup-key selection is not asserted by this headless harness; native select semantics are retained.

README, docs index, workspace navigation/configuration guidance and stale developer reference updated. Historical UX heading retained for its existing anchors. Local links/anchors checked in maintained entry points and relevant references.

722 unit tests, all 222 browser cases, 18 workbench checks and unchanged quality gates passed across the full run and the corrected-selector recheck. Five targeted browser cases first checked shared task navigation and retained-map returns, including the mobile layering correction.

fullRun.result: Format, types, lint and 722 unit tests passed; 220 browser cases passed. Two starter cases stopped on an ambiguous test locator after adding direct Documentation access.

correctedSelectorRecheck.result: Both cases passed after scoping the locator to the Project tools dialog; runtime unchanged.

documentationLinks.scope: Maintained entry points and relevant current references; local paths and Markdown headings only, no external URL availability or historical artifact rewrite.

limits: Automated technical evidence and visual screenshot inspection are not representative-human validation.
No blanket REQ-009 or need-satisfaction promotion.
No primitive, storage, integration or application-model extension.
Local link check does not verify external URL availability or rewrite historical evidence.
